thread:
alex: FYI - looks like incidentbot failed to page the oncall chain for `payment-ingress-5xx`
incbot: [automated] delivery_failed webhook_id=abc123 error=attachment_size_exceeded filter_ttl=0
maria: Wait — customer impact? did we actually lose pages or just slack mentions?
raj: I was oncall. I got a slack mention in #incidents but no phone or SMS. missed pages 01:02-01:08 UTC window
sre-bot: alerting status: primary escalation suppressed by automation rule (attachment filter) since 01:02:13
laura: seeing `filter_ttl` drop to 0 in the config -> automation treats as expired -> suppresses external pages
alex: where did the TTL come from? recent deploy?
incbot: recent deploy id=deploy-2026-03-18-3 - updated filter behaviour. logs show repeated exceptions:
```
ERROR 2026-03-18T01:02:12Z webhook_handler.go:142 attachment_size_exceeded: size=2.4MB filter_ttl=0
WARN  2026-03-18T01:02:13Z routing.go:87 suppressing externalescalation true
```
maria: customer-facing impact? any support tickets from that window?
raj: support saw 14 errors, two customers reported degraded checkout. I opened a P1 ticket in zendesk  #ZD-1129
laura: mitigation plan: temporarily revert filter TTL change and re-enable legacy webhook fanout. patch incoming.
laura: run:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/incbot FILTER_TTL=120
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/incbot
```
alex: done? who will manual-page while we roll?
laura: triggered env change at 01:05, rollout in progress
alex: manual page to primary (raj) sent at 01:06
raj: acked at 01:07, triaging logs now
incbot: debug dump for recent events (truncated):
```
{"ts":"2026-03-18T01:02:12Z","id":"abc123","reason":"attachment_size_exceeded","action":"suppress"}
{"ts":"2026-03-18T01:03:00Z","id":"abc124","reason":"ttl_parse_error","action":"suppress"}
```
maria: can we add a guard so large attachments still trigger phone pages? small tweak to routing rules.
laura: yes - will add fallback rule: if alert severity >= 2 -> bypass attachment filter
alex: assigning follow-up: laura to ship fallback rule, raj to add regression test in alert-sim harness, maria to update postmortem with customer-impact
raj: ETA on fix + tests? aiming EOD
laura: I'll open CR and start PR now, push to canary after tests
sre-bot: incident severity set to SEV2. recording timeline and owners.
alex: thanks team — doc the manual page procedure in runbook so first responders know to manual-page if automation suppresses. :thumbsup:
